description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different query selection strategies. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).”, has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  

The line representing “DPR w/o query” is black, solid, and begins at approximately 35.3 at an x-value of 1, increasing slightly to approximately 35.5 by an x-value of 10. The line representing “DPR w/ gold” is yellow, solid, starting at approximately 33.2 at an x-value of 1 and increasing sharply to approximately 36.1 at an x-value of 10. The line representing “DPR w/ top-1” is purple, solid, beginning at approximately 35.2 at an x-value of 1, increasing and then leveling off at approximately 35.4 from an x-value of 8 to 10.  The line representing “DPR w/ bottom-1” is blue, dashed, starting at approximately 35.1 at an x-value of 1 and increasing slightly to approximately 35.2 by an x-value of 10. The line representing “DPR w/ random” is red, dashed, starting at approximately 35.5 at an x-value of 1 and increasing to approximately 35.7 at an x-value of 10. The line representing “DPR w/ curriculum” is orange, solid, starting at approximately 34.0 at an x-value of 1 and increasing sharply to approximately 36.3 at an x-value of 10.
